description: Search the How to pay catalog by free text — how to pay — Stripe for humans, x402 USDC for agents. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use rail_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: rail_search
